# Shared test fixtures

- `sender-check-cases.json` and `verification-code-cases.json` hold the answers of the deleted `src/utils/senderCheck.js` and `src/utils/verificationCode.js` at origin/main `f66b58621`, which `src-core/src/sender_check.rs` and `src-core/src/verification_code.rs` must match. Regenerate with `node src-core/tests/fixtures/gen/parity-fixtures.mjs` (reads that JS out of git); `git diff` must stay empty.
- `transfer-limits-cases.json` and `vault-dir-mailbox-cases.json` hold the answers of the deleted `src/utils/transferLimits.js` (with the warning loop of `TransferLimitBanner.jsx`) and of `mailboxPathFromVaultDir` in `src/stores/slices/unifiedHelpers.js` at local main `65040308f`, which `src-core/src/transfer_limits.rs` and `src-core/src/search_index/text.rs` must match. Regenerate with `node src-core/tests/fixtures/gen/limits-policy-fixtures.mjs` (reads that JS out of git); `git diff` must stay empty.
- `fetch-policy-cases.json` and `vault_dir_names.json` were shared with JS ports that are gone too (`src/utils/fetchPolicy.js`, `vaultDirName`); they now pin the Rust alone.
- `notify-policy-cases.json` holds the answers of the deleted `src/utils/notificationPolicy.js` `decide()` at main `65040308f` (checked against it by the vitest `src/utils/__tests__/notificationPolicyFixture.test.js`, deleted with it), which `src-core/src/notify_policy.rs` must match.
- `cleanup-rule-cases.json` holds the answers of the deleted `src/services/cleanupEngine.js` (with `src/utils/cleanupFolders.js`), checked by `tests/unit/cleanupRuleParity.test.js` at `8072cc586` before both were removed; `src-core/src/cleanup_rules.rs` must select the same deletes. The inputs are generated by `gen/cleanup-rule-cases.mjs` (`node src-core/tests/fixtures/gen/cleanup-rule-cases.mjs src-core/tests/fixtures/cleanup-rule-cases.json`); the expected answers in it are the JS's.

- `account-logical-key-cases.json` contains the exact eight held input/answer pairs from blob `f45d3cbf987ba63616bd3e45cf5f4995f19a9a7b`. Both Rust and the current production JavaScript `accountLogicalKey` read it. A new remote Vitest execution on the N2 account preparation tree passed all eight cases against unchanged `src/services/db/accounts.js` blob `149de4b4fb5f9bee81a9101a025122269c566374` (`npx vitest run src/services/db/__tests__/accountLogicalKey.test.js`, 3 tests passed, including the fixture consumer and existing JMAP controls). The N2 evidence records the command, fixture SHA256 and output; this is current execution parity, not a historical generation claim. Rust did not generate the expected answers.
